port_difficulty.why: Eight lines: one MOVE of the literal 1 to SH-CUST-ID and GOBACK. No I/O, no arithmetic, no branches.

blast_radius.why: Touches no dataset and nothing in the tree calls it, but the tree holds no JCL or scheduler, so its place in the nightly batch cycle is unverified.

units.driving_fact: Includes SHARED01, the same layout copybook PROGB includes, so both programs change together whenever SH-CUST-ID or the COMP-3 SH-BALANCE field changes.
